en.t: 3 tbsp (45 ml) plus 60 ml extra-virgin olive oil, divided
2 medium cloves garlic, minced (about 2 tsp (10 ml))
710 ml hearty bread, cut into 2 cm cubes
57 g finely grated Parmesan cheese (about 240 ml), divided
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
1 large egg yolk
1 tbsp (15 ml) juice from 1 lemon
2 to 6 anchovies
1 tsp (5 ml) Worcestershire sauce
80 ml canola oil
2 heads romaine lettuce, inner leaves only, washed and carefully dried, large leaves torn into smaller pieces, smaller leaves left intact

1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C). In a small bowl, combine 3 tbsp (45 ml) olive oil with minced garlic and whisk for 30 seconds. Transfer to a fine-mesh strainer set over a large bowl and press with the back of a spoon to extract as much oil as possible, leaving garlic behind. Reserve pressed garlic separately. Add bread cubes to garlic oil and toss to coat.

2. Add 2 tbsp (10 g) parmesan cheese, toss again, and season to taste with salt and pepper. Transfer to a rimmed baking sheet. Bake until croutons are pale golden brown and crisp, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven and toss with 2 more tbsp parmesan. Allow to cool.

3. While croutons bake, make the dressing. Combine egg yolk, lemon juice, anchovies, Worcestershire sauce, pressed garlic, and 60 ml (about 14 g) parmesan cheese in the bottom of a cup that just fits the head of an immersion blender or in the bottom of a food processor. With blender or processor running, slowly drizzle in canola oil until a smooth emulsion forms. Transfer mixture to a medium bowl. Whisking constantly, slowly drizzle in remaining 60 ml extra-virgin olive oil. Season to taste generously with salt and pepper.

4. To serve, toss lettuce with a few tbsp of dressing, adding more if desired. Once lettuce is coated, add half of remaining cheese and three-quarters of croutons and toss again. Transfer to a salad bowl and sprinkle with remaining cheese and croutons. Serve.

1. Mriežku v rúre dáme do strednej polohy a rúru predhrejeme na 190 °C (teplovzdušnú na 170 °C). V malej miske zmiešame 2¼ PL (33 ml) olivového oleja s nadrobno nasekaným cesnakom a 30 sekúnd šľaháme metličkou. Preložíme do jemného sitka nad veľkou misou a chrbtom lyžice pretlačíme, aby sme dostali čo najviac oleja, cesnak zostane v sitku. Pretlačený cesnak odložíme zvlášť. Kocky chleba premiešame s cesnakovým olejom, aby sa obalili.

2. Pridáme 2 PL (10 g) parmezánu, znova premiešame a podľa chuti osolíme a okoreníme. Preložíme na plech s okrajom. Pečieme, kým krutóny nie sú svetlozlatisté a chrumkavé, asi 15 minút. Vyberieme z rúry a premiešame s ďalšími 2 PL parmezánu. Necháme vychladnúť.

3. Kým sa krutóny pečú, pripravíme dresing. Do pohára, do ktorého sa práve zmestí hlava ponorného mixéra, alebo do nádoby kuchynského robota dáme žĺtok, citrónovú šťavu, ančovičky, worcesterskú omáčku, pretlačený cesnak a 60 ml (asi 14 g) parmezánu. Za chodu mixéra alebo robota pomaly prilievame repkový olej, kým nevznikne hladká emulzia. Zmes preložíme do strednej misy. Za stáleho šľahania pomaly prilievame zvyšných 45 ml extra panenského olivového oleja. Podľa chuti výdatne osolíme a okoreníme.

4. Pred podávaním premiešame šalát s niekoľkými lyžicami dresingu, podľa chuti pridáme viac. Keď je šalát obalený, pridáme polovicu zvyšného syra a tri štvrtiny krutónov a znova premiešame. Preložíme do šalátovej misy a posypeme zvyšným syrom a krutónmi. Podávame.

en.t: 55 g red onion (1/4 medium onion), thinly sliced pole to pole
60 ml red wine vinegar
340 g mixed ripe tomatoes, cut into slices and chunks

Kosher or sea salt

1. In a small bowl, combine onion with vinegar and let soak while you prepare the other ingredients, about 15 minutes. Drain onions, reserving vinegar.

c.t: Potatoes cooked ahead and refrigerated can be revived: crush each gently under a heavy pot and sear in very hot olive oil in a cast-iron skillet until browned in spots; cool before adding to the salad.
Tuna is optional: the anchovies carry the salad, but you can add tuna or use it instead of the anchovies (not in the vinaigrette).

Zemiaky uvarené vopred a vychladené oživíte: každý zľahka roztlačte ťažkým hrncom a opečte na veľmi horúcom olivovom oleji na liatinovej panvici, kým miestami nezhnednú; pred pridaním do šalátu ich nechajte vychladnúť.
Tuniak je nepovinný: ančovičky šalát unesú, ale tuniaka môžete pridať alebo ním ančovičky nahradiť (nie však vo vinaigrette).

en.t: 1 small shallot, minced (about 2 tbsp (30 ml))
1 small clove garlic, minced (about 1/2 tsp (2.5 ml))
2 tsp (10 ml) Dijon mustard
4 cured anchovy fillets, either oil-packed or fully cleaned and prepped salt-packed ones, minced (about 1 tsp (5 ml))
3 tbsp (44 ml) white wine vinegar
1 tbsp (15 ml) water
175 ml extra-virgin olive oil
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
340 g small waxy potatoes (about 4 potatoes), such as young Yukon Golds
1/2 medium onion
2 sprigs fresh thyme
4 medium cloves garlic
70 g kosher salt, plus more for seasoning
455 g string beans, preferably French haricots verts, trimmed
4 large eggs
225 g ripe tomatoes, preferably a small variety or cherry tomatoes, halved, quartered, or cut into wedges (depending on size)
10 anchovy fillets, either oil-packed or fully cleaned and prepped salt-packed ones, cut into 2.5 cm lengths
1 can (about 250 g) oil-packed bonito tuna, such as Ortiz, drained (optional)
175 ml pitted small black olives, such as Niçoise or Taggiasca, drained
2 tbsp (30 ml) drained brined capers
20 torn fresh basil leaves
85 g lettuce greens, such as a good mesclun mix, arugula, mizuna, and/or butter lettuce
Freshly ground black pepper

1. For the Vinaigrette: Combine shallot, garlic, mustard, anchovies, vinegar, and water in a large bowl and whisk to combine. Whisking constantly, slowly drizzle in olive oil. Alternatively, place all ingredients in a tightly sealing jar, seal, and shake vigorously until emulsified. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Vinaigrette will keep in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

2. For the Salad: In a large saucepan, cover potatoes with at least 5 cm of water. Add onion, thyme, and garlic. Stir in 120 ml salt until dissolved. Set over medium-high heat and bring just to a simmer. Lower heat to just barely below a simmer and cook until potatoes are easily pierced by a fork, about 40 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand in cooking water until cooled slightly. Drain potatoes. If using right away, allow to cool to room temperature, then crumble and set aside. If making 1 day ahead, store potatoes in the refrigerator, then revive by gently crushing with the bottom of a saucepan and frying in a cast iron skillet; allow to cool to room temperature, then crumble and set aside.

3. Meanwhile, fill a large saucepan with water and season generously with salt. Fill a large bowl with ice water. Bring saucepan of water to a boil. Working in small batches, cook beans until tender-crisp, about 3 minutes. Transfer to ice bath to chill. Drain beans and pat dry; beans can be refrigerated overnight at this point. Cut beans into 4 cm length and set aside.

4. Add 1 tray of ice cubes to another large bowl and fill with water. Add 2.5 cm of water to a large pot. Place steamer insert inside, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Add eggs to steamer basket, cover, and continue cooking 9 minutes. Immediately place eggs in bowl of ice water and allow to cool for at least 15 minutes before peeling under cool running water. Store in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. Cut eggs into quarters lengthwise.

5. In a large bowl, combine potatoes, green beans, tomatoes, anchovy fillets, tuna (if using), olives, capers, basil, and lettuce greens. Shake or whisk vinaigrette, then drizzle a small amount over ingredients in bowl, tossing gently with clean hands and adding more vinaigrette as needed until everything is lightly coated. Season with salt and pepper. Transfer salad to serving bowls and garnish with eggs.

en.t: 170 g pita (about 2 thick 20 cm pitas), split and cut into 2 cm squares

1. For the Pita Chips: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Spread pita on a rimmed baking sheet and bake, using a wooden spoon or flexible spatula to stir halfway through cooking, until squares are completely dry, toasted, crisp, and beginning to darken in color, about 15 minutes. Let pita cool fully, about 15 minutes. Set aside.
2. For the Dressing: In a small screw-top jar, combine olive oil, lemon juice, pomegranate molasses, garlic, and salt. Tightly seal and shake vigorously until fully combined, about 30 seconds.

3. In a large, wide bowl, combine romaine lettuce, purslane, parsley, mint, scallions, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, pepper, radishes, and the toasted pita. Pour all of the dressing over the vegetables and, with clean hands and wearing gloves if desired, very lightly toss to evenly coat salad with dressing. Season to taste with salt. Transfer to a serving bowl, top with grated halloumi, and sprinkle with the sumac. Serve immediately.

c.t: Adjust the heat with more or fewer Thai chillies. Dried shrimp are sold in Asian markets and online.
Palm sugar must be softened (about 15 seconds in the microwave) to mix into the dressing; light brown sugar can replace it. Green papaya is unripe, crisp and not sweet.
Pálivosť upravte množstvom thajských čili papričiek. Sušené krevety dostanete v ázijských obchodoch a online.
Palmový cukor treba zmäkčiť (asi 15 sekúnd v mikrovlnke), aby sa dal zamiešať do dresingu; nahradiť ho môže svetlý hnedý cukor. Zelená papája je nezrelá, chrumkavá a nesladká.

en.t: 2 small garlic cloves (6 g)
2 to 3 fresh Thai chiles (2 to 3 g total), stemmed
1 tbsp (8 g) dried shrimp
2 tbsp (30 g) roasted unsalted peanuts, divided
1 tbsp plus 2 tsp (35 g) palm sugar, softened
4 cherry tomatoes (about 60 g), halved
2 long beans (about 30 g), ends trimmed, cut crosswise into 5 cm pieces
3 tbsp (45 ml) fresh lime juice from 2 limes
2 tbsp (30 ml) fish sauce
170 g shredded green papaya, from 1 green papaya
Cooked sticky rice, for serving

1. In a clay or wooden mortar, combine garlic and chiles and pound with wooden pestle until slightly broken down, making sure to keep the pestle as close to the chiles as possible to avoid splattering chile juices over yourself, about 30 seconds. Add dried shrimp and 1 tbsp (15 g) peanuts and continue to pound until slightly broken down, taking care not to over-pound and form a peanut paste, about 30 seconds.

2. Add palm sugar and continue to pound lightly while also working the pestle in a circular motion while applying gentle pressure to help dissolve the palm sugar, about 30 seconds. Add long beans and pound until slightly broken down, 15 to 30 seconds. Add tomatoes and pound gently just until the tomatoes release their juices, about 15 seconds.

3. Add lime juice and fish sauce and stir with pestle using a circular motion until well combined and palm sugar is fully dissolved, about 15 seconds. Add green papaya. Holding a large spoon in your non-dominant hand while holding the pestle in your dominant hand, pound down the sides of the mortar (not the center) while simultaneously using the spoon to move the ingredients back and forth in the mortar until ingredients are well combined and green papaya has begun to absorb the dressing, about 30 seconds. Take care not to over-pound the green papaya or it will lose its crisp texture.
4. Add remaining 1 tbsp (15 g) peanuts and pound gently just until they are slightly broken down. Transfer salad to a serving plate, and serve immediately with sticky rice.

1. V hlinenom alebo drevenom mažiari roztlčieme drevenou paličkou cesnak a čili papričky, kým sa trochu nerozdrvia; paličku držíme čo najbližšie pri papričkách, aby sme sa nepostriekali ich pálivou šťavou, asi 30 sekúnd. Pridáme sušené krevety a 1 PL (15 g) arašidov a tlčieme ďalej, kým sa trochu nerozdrvia; dávame pozor, aby sme ich neroztĺkli na arašidovú pastu, asi 30 sekúnd.

2. Pridáme palmový cukor a zľahka tlčieme ďalej, pričom paličkou zároveň krúžime a jemne pritláčame, aby sa palmový cukor rozpustil, asi 30 sekúnd. Pridáme dlhú fazuľku a tlčieme, kým sa trochu nerozdrví, 15 až 30 sekúnd. Pridáme paradajky a jemne tlčieme, len kým nepustia šťavu, asi 15 sekúnd.

3. Pridáme limetkovú šťavu a rybaciu omáčku a krúživým pohybom paličky miešame, kým sa všetko dobre nespojí a palmový cukor sa úplne nerozpustí, asi 15 sekúnd. Pridáme zelenú papáju. Vo voľnej ruke držíme veľkú lyžicu a v dominantnej paličku; tlčieme po stenách mažiara (nie do stredu) a súčasne lyžicou presúvame suroviny sem a tam, kým sa dobre nespoja a papája nezačne nasávať dresing, asi 30 sekúnd. Dávame pozor, aby sme papáju nepretĺkli, inak stratí chrumkavosť.
4. Pridáme zvyšnú 1 PL (15 g) arašidov a jemne tlčieme, len kým sa trochu nerozdrvia. Šalát preložíme na servírovací tanier a ihneď podávame s lepkavou ryžou.

c.t: Toasted glutinous rice powder is sold in Thai markets, or toast glutinous rice in a dry skillet over medium heat until nutty brown, about 8 minutes, and grind it fine (not quite to powder). Do not omit it: it adds flavour and binds.

With store-bought ground chicken, dinner is ready in under 30 minutes; when grinding your own, do not over-pulse into a paste. The oil can be omitted. Balance hot, sour, salty and sweet at the table with fish sauce, lime juice and chilli flakes.

Praženú múku z lepkavej ryže dostanete v thajských obchodoch, alebo lepkavú ryžu opražte na suchej panvici na strednom ohni dooriškovohneda, asi 8 minút, a jemne ju pomeľte (nie celkom na prach). Nevynechávajte ju: dodá chuť a spája.

S kupovaným mletým kuracím je večera hotová za menej ako 30 minút; ak meliete sami, nepulzujte príliš, aby nevznikla pasta. Olej môžete vynechať. Rovnováhu pálivého, kyslého, slaného a sladkého doladíte pri stole rybou omáčkou, limetkovou šťavou a čili vločkami.

en.t: 680 g skinless boneless chicken breast (or pre-ground chicken breast)
120 ml chicken stock
2 tsp (10 ml) vegetable oil
2 tsp (8 g) granulated sugar, plus extra as desired
1/4 tsp (1.5 g) salt
6 large cloves garlic, minced (about 2 tbsp (30 ml))
4 to 6 tbsp (59–89 ml) fresh juice from about 6 limes, plus extra as desired
5 to 6 tbsp (74–89 ml) fish sauce, plus extra as desired
3/4 tsp (3.5 ml) dried red chili flakes (preferable Thai), plus extra as desired
6 small shallots, peeled and sliced into thin rings (about 235 ml)
295 ml fresh mint leaves, chopped
295 ml fresh cilantro leaves, chopped

790 g–1190 g cooked rice, preferably glutinous
extra fish sauce, lime wedges, chili flakes, sugar on the side
1 large head iceberg lettuce or green leaf

1. Trim chicken of visible fat and cut into 2.5 cm cubes. Place in single layer on tray and freeze until partially frozen, about 30 minutes. Working in 2 or 3 batches, pulse chicken in food processor until roughly ground into pieces the size of small peas; set aside.

2. In a large 30 cm skillet (or wok), heat the chicken stock over medium-high heat with the oil, sugar, and salt. Add the chicken and the garlic, and cook until the chicken is just cooked through, stirring and breaking up the chicken, about 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in the lime juice, fish sauce, and chili flakes. Stir in the shallots, mint, and cilantro.
3. Stir in the ground toasted rice. Season to taste with more sugar, lime juice, fish sauce, and chili flakes as desired. Serve the larb warm or at room temperature with rice and lettuce.

1. Mayonnaise: blend yolks, vinegar and seasoning until creamy; trickle in the oil drop by drop to a thick mayonnaise; stabilise with 1–2 tbsp (15–30 ml) cold water.

en.t: 1360 g yellow potatoes (about 5 medium potatoes)
2 medium carrots (227 g total), peeled and ends trimmed
3 tsp (9 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt, plus more for cooking water and to taste; for table salt, use half as much by volume or the same weight
128 g frozen peas
5 large hard-boiled eggs, finely chopped
420 ml store-bought or homemade mayonnaise or aioli
1 (142 g) can drained tuna in oil
1 tbsp (15 ml) sherry vinegar
235 ml poached shrimp (optional)
50 g pitted or pimento-stuffed olives (optional)
8 anchovy fillets (optional)

1. In a large pot, cover potatoes and carrots with cold water and season generously with salt. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a gentle simmer and cook until the potatoes are easily pierced with a knife and the carrots are fully tender, 20 to 30 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer potatoes and carrots to a cutting board and let sit until cool enough to handle, about 20 minutes; do not drain cooking water.

2. Meanwhile, add peas to still-boiling cooking water and cook until bright green and tender, about 2 minutes. Drain well and transfer to a large bowl; set aside. Using a clean kitchen towel, gently rub the potatoes to loosen and remove the skin. Cut potatoes and carrots into 1.5 cm pieces; transfer to bowl with peas.

3. Add eggs, mayonnaise or aioli, tuna, sherry vinegar, and the 3 tsp (15 ml) kosher salt to bowl and gently fold to combine. Season to taste with salt, if needed. Cover and refrigerate until flavors meld, at least 30 minutes and up to 4 days.
4. To Serve: Transfer potato salad to a large serving platter. Top decoratively with shrimp, olives, and anchovies, if using.
